title: VIP Roadmap Concierge: Weighted Admission Matrix and Deferment Credits
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build a gated, auditable intake and prioritization flow for VIP/top-account feature requests and escalations that balances business urgency with engineering velocity. The Concierge introduces a weighted admission matrix, deferred-credit mechanism for schedule negotiation, and an operator dashboard for reconciliation and transparency.
background: Top accounts frequently escalate roadmap asks during renewal windows, creating one-off fast-path requests that disrupt sprint planning and degrade reliability. Current ad-hoc handling leads to opaque commitments, missed SLAs, and churn risk. We need a repeatable, measurable intake policy that captures trade-offs and preserves predictable delivery for the broader customer base.
proposal: Introduce a VIP Roadmap Concierge consisting of three components: (1) Weighted Admission Matrix that scores requests by ARR, renewal proximity, regulatory risk, strategic partnership status, and feasibility; (2) Deferment Credits system where PMs/CS teams can spend limited credits to fast-track items with explicit trade-offs; (3) Concierge Dashboard for reconciliation showing admitted items, deferred credits ledger, committed runways, and associated engineering cost buckets. The flow integrates with Linear, Slack triage channel, and the Console usage dashboards for telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Admission matrix implemented as a scoring config in the Roadmap Intake form and documented in the Concierge playbook. 2) Deferment Credits pilot enabled with a 10-credit pool scoped to Customer Success and named account AEs. 3) Concierge Dashboard shows live list of active VIP lanes, credits spent, and ETA windows. 4) Pilot covers 3 accounts from distinct segments (SaaS scale-up, regulated enterprise, and strategic partner). 5) Engineering delivery backlog reflects admitted items with tagged capacity impact and rollback policies. 6) All admitted items have a documented fallback (model variant/region/limited rollout) and a signed stakeholder acceptance record.
success_metrics: - Reduce unplanned emergency sprints for top accounts by 60% in quarter. - Decrease time-to-commit for VIP asks from triage to roadmap ticket by 40%. - Achieve >=90% fulfilment of concierge ADMITTED items within agreed runway for pilot accounts. - Prevented churn (measured by renewal outcomes) for at least one pilot account attributed to concierge process. - Transparent credits usage: at least 80% of fast-tracks include explicit trade-off notes recorded.
milestones: - 2026-03-15: Finalize admission weights and credit policy (PM + CS + Eng alignment). - 2026-03-31: Implement intake form changes and Linear automation rules. - 2026-04-10: Launch Deferment Credits pilot and Slack triage channel. - 2026-04-20: Concierge Dashboard V1 in internal Console (read-only). - 2026-05-01: Pilot review and iteration; prepare roll-forward plan.
timeline: Quarterly pilot aimed at Q2 kickoff; initial internal rollout during Cycle 2026-W12, evaluation at end of Cycle 2026-W18.
stakeholders: PM: Aisha Kapoor; EC/CS Lead: Samuel Ortega; Eng Lead: Priya Raman; Solutions/AE liaison: Daniel Park; Head of Revenue: Sofia Martinez; Legal/Security reviewer: Elena Novak.
risks: - Gaming the matrix by inflating signals (mitigation: audit and manual spot checks). - Engineering capacity overruns if credits are overspent (mitigation: hard credit cap and engineering veto Power). - Perceived unfairness from non-VIP customers (mitigation: public-facing policy and quota for community requests). - Data accuracy for signals like ARR/renewal proximity (mitigation: pull canonical values from CRM and require AE confirmation).
mitigation: Enforce a three-person admission gate for any >8 score requests, automatic deny for items missing critical security/regulatory signoff, and monthly reconciliation meetings between PM, Eng, and CS. Build telemetry to flag credit exhaustion and set a soft stop on new admits.
rollout_plan: 1) Internal pilot with 3 accounts and concierge ops playbook. 2) After 6-week pilot and KPI check, enable for top-25 accounts behind a portaled 'apply for VIP lane' UI. 3) Formalize SLA language for enterprise contracts tied to concierge options as part of Dedicated/Private deals.
open_questions: - What are the exact weights for ARR vs. renewal proximity vs. regulatory risk? - Who owns final veto: Eng lead or Head of PM? - Should credits reset each quarter or roll over? - How to surface deferred trade-offs to engineering planning tools (Linear/ZenHub/Backlog)?
notes: Design should be lightweight for Phase 1 — a Google Form + Linear webhook may be sufficient. The Concierge Dashboard should reuse existing Console widgets where possible to avoid a bespoke product build. Consider integration with Redwood Optimize signals to auto-suggest quantization or cost-saving options when admitting a request.
